candidates.change_summary: Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll to allow anyone to call it and change the withdrawAll behavior.
Change withdrawAll to withdraw 0 instead of the full balance, so the owner receives nothing.
Delete the entire body of withdrawAll so it does nothing and no funds are transferred.
Remove the require statement in onlyOwner modifier so anyone can pass the guard and call withdrawAll.
Delete the transfer statement so withdraw does not send any ether.
Replace the transfer call with a selfdestruct to the owner, so the contract is destroyed and ether is sent differently.
Delete the require statement in onlyOwner, removing access control so anyone can call withdraw.
Remove the require statement that checks the result of the low-level call, allowing sendMoney to succeed silently even when the external call fails.

Replace the low-level call with a delegatecall, which will execute the target's code in the context of contract C, potentially changing C's storage and making the call always appear to succeed from C's perspective.
Remove the require statement from the onlyOwner modifier, allowing any caller to invoke sendMoney.
